test_title: PYST 39: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

HEROES : LBVLBW :: INVEST : FRZBWX :: KIDNAP : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• Consonants → (4) is added to from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Vowels → (3) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• HEROES : LBVLBW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cb6ce223a7331a4bce198866a7ff2239f0af8204a17e814b6da5240238f210e.png] 

And,

 
• INVEST : FRZBWX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4ea9c9b5554f362c144f7c2375de3903dbae91fd43a12da4fab8e5465920679.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• KIDNAP : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94e44c08084ce2a227f90e3f83fc5f43870acc9fb0f7ad7e031d4173292cd1d4.png] 

​Hence, the correct answer is "**OFHRXT**".

68
